occupancy: Rooms run single, double or triple depending on seniority: seniors and research scholars get single or double rooms where space allows, and most first-year undergraduates share triple rooms.
messNote: Each hostel runs its own centralised, air-conditioned mess serving breakfast, lunch, evening snacks and dinner on a fixed daily schedule; the girls' hostels additionally have their own dedicated air-conditioned mess and gym.
